checklist.action: Confirm that a licensed Stata executable is available and record the executable path used as STATA_EXE.
Read tests/stata_parity/STATA_ENVIRONMENT.md and decide whether to refresh the local ado inventory before rerunning.
Run either the Paper-JSS Tier-3 driver or the direct tests/stata_parity/verify_reproduce_stata.py command.
checklist.expected_record: command, exit code, and elapsed time

checklist.action: Confirm that REPRODUCIBILITY_REPORT_STATA.md lists 85/85 reproduced modules and zero non-reproduced rows.
If any row drifts, inspect the module, Stata version, ado version, tolerance override, and generated log before changing golden JSON.
Do not overwrite committed *_Stata.json golden files unless the drift is explained and the manuscript/audits are refreshed in the same reviewed change.
checklist.expected_record: golden files unchanged or justified refresh

checklist.action: If Stata is absent, record an optional-runtime skip rather than a JSS upload failure; no Section 4-7 headline number depends on live Stata.
After any accepted Stata rerun update, rerun the Stata bridge audit and the JSS submission package verifier.

commands.purpose: Runs Tier 1, Tier 2 if R is available, and the licensed Stata verifier through the paper reproduction driver.
Runs only the Stata parity verifier and rewrites the Stata reproducibility report from staged fresh outputs.
Optional: refreshes the Stata engine/ado inventory when a reviewer reruns under a different licensed Stata installation.
Checks the frozen JSON/do/provenance bundle without requiring Stata; this remains the JSS upload evidence.

scope: Optional licensed Stata Tier-3 rerun protocol; the JSS upload evidence remains the frozen JSON/do/provenance bundle.
